import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_53/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_53/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_53/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_53/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_53/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_53/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_53/training_6.csv",
]

# Read all source files into dataframes with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Concatenate all dataframes (UNION operation)
Target6_53 = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
Target6_53['nombre'] = Target6_53['nombre'].astype(str)
Target6_53['n_concursados'] = Target6_53['n_concursados'].astype(int)
Target6_53['n_aprobados'] = Target6_53['n_aprobados'].astype(int)
Target6_53['año'] = Target6_53['año'].astype(int)

# Write the final target table to the specified path without the index
Target6_53.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_53/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
